services.desc: Pre-purchased tickets are strongly recommended. Walk-in admissions will be available as space allows. To ensure a safe and positive play experience we have a limit on how many guests can be in the museum at one time. On particularly busy days, visits may be limited to 90 mins. Nurses or aides that are accompanying a special needs child with their family or adult guardian will receive free admission with proper identification. services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Get ready for a summer filled with creativity, imagination, and play! With hands-on and self-guided activities, camp sessions are packed with opportunities for kids to construct their own learning through play, make friends, and explore exciting themes that inspire discovery. Campers are welcome to sign up for 1 week or multiple to extend the wonder! Browse our camp themes, dates, and FAQ's below to find the perfect fit for your child’s next adventure. Campers will experiment and make all kinds of messy projects! From ooblek to cloud dough to fizzy painting and more, campers will create and play with all kinds of sensory activities.
